title: Create delivery record when delivery method is selected
gherkin:
Feature: Delivery Lifecycle Management
  Scenario: Create delivery record for delivery method selection
    Given an authenticated user has created a rent request for an available rentable item
    And the user selects delivery as the fulfillment method
    And delivery scheduling and time-window validation passes
    When the system processes the delivery method selection
    Then a delivery record shall be created and associated with the rent record
    And the delivery record shall be initialized with status Scheduled
rationale: Validates that delivery records are created only when delivery method is explicitly selected, and that the record is properly associated with the rent request and initialized with the correct initial status.
usedContextItems: The system shall create a delivery record associated with the rent record when delivery is selected.|Delivery scheduling and time-window validation must occur before delivery record creation.|The system shall support delivery status values including Scheduled, In Transit, Delivered, and Failed.

# Documentum ID: TOOLCHAIN-CONF-DELIVERY-01
# Description: Delivery Management
# Status: Effective

## 8. Delivery Management

## 8.1.1 The system shall allow users to choose a delivery method for a rent, including pickup and delivery.

## 8.1.3 The system shall validate the delivery address before confirming the rent.

## 8.2 Delivery Scheduling
## 8.2.1 The system shall allow users to select a delivery time window.
## 8.2.2 The system shall validate that the selected delivery time window is available.

# Documentum ID: TOOLCHAIN-CONF-DELIVERY-01
# Description: Delivery Management
# Status: Effective

## 8. Delivery Management

## 8.1 Delivery Options
## 8.1.1 The system shall allow users to choose a delivery method for a rent, including pickup and delivery.
## 8.1.2 The system shall require the user to provide a delivery address when delivery is selected.
## 8.1.3 The system shall validate the delivery address before confirming the rent.

## 8.2 Delivery Scheduling
## 8.2.1 The system shall allow users to select a delivery time window.
## 8.2.2 The system shall validate that the selected delivery time window is available.
## 8.2.3 The system shall prevent scheduling delivery outside supported delivery hours.

## 8.3.1 The system shall create a delivery record associated with the rent record when delivery is selected.
